description.narrative: Improve access to sustainable and resilient municipal infrastructure and services in participating cities.

The proposed Green and Future Cities (GFC) Project is a coordinated World Bank Group (WBG) initiative that integrates International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and International Finance Corporation (IFC) support to ILBANK and metropolitan municipalities in Turkiye to deliver scalable, sustainable and resilient urban infrastructure and services. The initiative will help participating municipalities address urban development and municipal investment finance challenges by leveraging the international expertise and technical knowledge of IBRD and IFC to provide a broader range of tailored financing instruments. Under the IBRD operation, the Project will deliver a package of investments and technical assistance to the participating metropolitan municipalities to improve access to sustainable and resilient municipal infrastructure and services. The Project will have three components: (i) Component 1. Integrated, multi-sectoral investments in participating municipalities: The component will support municipal investments contributing to more livable, productive, and climate resilient urban infrastructure and services in the participating municipalities. The eligible sector list is expected to include urban transport, and water and sanitation. This component will cover Antalya and Konya Metropolitan Municipalities; (ii) Component 2. Strengthening capacity of ILBANK and municipalities: The component will help ILBANK and eligible municipalities build institutional and technical capacity in municipal finance and sustainable and resilient urban management. (iii) Component 3. Project Management: The component will finance provision of goods, consulting and non-consulting services, operating costs, and training to ILBANK for Project management and implementation support activities.
